info:
What is TOPIK?

TOPIK이란?
Name한국어능력시험 (TOPIK, Test of Proficiency in Korean)
What it isA test of Korean language level for foreigners
2 typesTOPIK I = levels 1~2 (beginner)
TOPIK II = levels 3~6 (intermediate~advanced)
Valid for2 years from the day results are announced
Websitewww.topik.go.kr

TOPIK I (1~2급)

듣기 listening 30 questions (40 minutes) + 읽기 reading 40 questions (60 minutes). Full score 200.

80 points or more = 1급, 140 points or more = 2급. No writing.

TOPIK II (3~6급)

듣기 50 questions, 쓰기 writing 4 questions, 읽기 50 questions. Full score 300.

120 or more = 3급, 150 = 4급, 190 = 5급, 230 = 6급.

What is it used for?

Entering a university in Korea (many need level 3 or higher), applying for scholarships, visas and jobs at Korean companies.

The TOPIK section of this app focuses on levels 1~4. Some lessons have a 'taste' of levels 5~6.

Information (number of questions, time, scores) can change. Always check the TOPIK website before you apply.

Words

시험 siheomtest, exam
급 geuplevel
점수 jeomsuscore
듣기 deutgilistening
읽기 ilgireading
쓰기 sseugiwriting
유효 기간 yuhyo giganvalid period

tq.dl: What levels does TOPIK I have?
tq.x: TOPIK I = levels 1 and 2. TOPIK II = levels 3 to 6.

tq.dl: Which one is NOT in TOPIK I?
tq.x: TOPIK I has only listening (듣기) and reading (읽기). Writing (쓰기) is in TOPIK II.

tq.dl: What level is 150 points in TOPIK I?
What level is 160 points in TOPIK II?
tq.x: 4급 = 150~189 points. 160 is in this range, so it is 4급.

tq.dl: What happens if you get 110 points in TOPIK II?
tq.x: TOPIK II starts 3급 at 120 points. 110 is not enough, so you get no level. TOPIK II does not give 1급·2급.

info:
Test day

시험 보는 날

Before test day

Apply online (TOPIK website) or ask the test center in your country. Some places test on paper (PBT), some test on computer (IBT).

Print your 수험표 (admission ticket) and prepare your 신분증 (ID card or passport).

In the test room

Arrive before the 입실 시간 (entry time). Turn off your phone and give it to the 감독관 (proctor). Smartwatches are not allowed.

Fill in answers on the 답안지 with a 컴퓨터용 사인펜 (computer marking pen), filling the circle ● completely. If you make a mistake, use 수정테이프 (correction tape).

Time

TOPIK I: listening and reading together, 100 minutes. TOPIK II: Part 1 listening + writing (110 minutes), break, Part 2 reading (70 minutes).

You cannot replay the listening audio. Read the choices before the audio starts.

tq.d: 시험장에 신분증 없이 수험표만 가지고 가도 됩니다.
tq.dl: You can go with only the admission ticket and no ID card.
tq.x: X. You need both a 수험표 (admission ticket) and a 신분증 (ID card or passport).

tq.dl: Fill in your answers with a pen for the scanning machine.
tq.x: O. The machine cannot read pencil or red pen. Fill the circle completely.

tq.d: 시험 중에 휴대폰을 시계로 사용할 수 있습니다.
tq.dl: You can check the time on your phone in the test room.
tq.x: X. Phones and smartwatches must be turned off and given to the proctor. Use a normal watch or the clock in the room.

tq.d: 입실 시간이 지나면 시험장에 들어갈 수 없습니다.
tq.dl: If you are late for the entry time, you cannot go in.
tq.x: O. Arrive before the entry time. If you are late, you may lose the chance to take the test.

tq.d: 듣기 음성은 못 들었으면 다시 들려 달라고 할 수 있습니다.
tq.dl: If you miss something in listening, you can ask them to play it again.
tq.x: X. The audio plays on a schedule and you cannot hear it again. So read the choices first and listen carefully.

info:
IBT: the computer test

IBT(컴퓨터 시험) 화면과 조작

What is IBT?

IBT = taking TOPIK on a computer at a test center. Some countries already use it; others still test on paper (PBT). The number of questions and time in IBT may be different from PBT.

ScreenThe question is in the middle; the question number and time left (남은 시간) are at the top
Choosing answersClick (클릭) a choice. You can change it before you submit
ListeningWear headphones. The audio plays by itself in order
Writing (II)Type with a Korean keyboard (입력). Practice typing before the test
Submit제출 = submit your answers. After you submit, you cannot change them

Get ready

Practice typing Korean on your phone and computer. The TOPIK website has an IBT practice version to try (check topik.go.kr).

화면 hwamyeonscreen
클릭 keullikclick
제출 jechulsubmission

tq.d: IBT 시험 순서로 알맞은 것을 고르십시오.
tq.dl: Which order is correct?
o: Log in → choose answers → check → submit
tq.x: Log in (check your name and number) → choose answers → check again → 제출 (submit). After you submit, you cannot change anything.

tq.dl: What does the 제출 button do?
tq.x: 제출 = to submit (documents, answers).

tq.dl: How do you write your writing answers in IBT?
tq.x: In IBT you type with a keyboard (키보드로 입력). If you type slowly, you lose time, so practice typing.

tq.dl: What is '남은 시간' on the screen?
tq.x: 남다 = to be left, 시간 = time. Check it often to manage your time.

info:
Time management and test strategies

시간 배분과 풀이 전략

Listening

1. Before the audio starts, read the 선택지 (choices) first and guess what you will hear.

2. For questions with 2 questions (a set), read both questions first.

3. If you miss it, choose quickly and go to the next question. Do not think about the old one.

Reading

1. Read the question first, then the text. Look for 핵심어 (key words).

2. For hard questions, 넘기다 (skip them first) and come back later.

3. The last questions (long texts) need more time: do not use all your time on the early questions.

The last 5 minutes

Check the answer sheet: did you fill in every question, and do the numbers match? Wrong answers do not lose points, so do not leave any question empty.

Words

핵심어 haeksimeokey word

tq.dl: What should you do before the audio starts?
tq.x: If you read the choices first, you know what to listen for (place, time, people…).

tq.dl: What should you do when you find a hard question in reading?
tq.x: Skip it first (넘기다) and come back. Every question has about the same points.

tq.d: 한 지문에 문제가 2개 있을 때 좋은 방법은?
tq.dl: What should you do when one text has 2 questions?
o: Read both questions first, then read the text
tq.x: If you know the questions first, you can read the text once and answer both.

tq.dl: It is better to leave questions you don't know empty.
tq.x: X. Wrong answers do not lose points. Choosing the closest answer is better than leaving it empty.

tq.dl: What should you check 5 minutes before the end?
o: Answer sheet: all filled in and the numbers match
tq.x: Check that you filled in every question and did not mark the wrong line.

info:
Calculating your score and setting a goal

점수 계산과 목표 급 세우기

Set a goal

Before the test, set a goal: which level do you want, and how many points do you need in each section?

TOPIK I 1급Total 80 or more (e.g. listening 40 + reading 40)
TOPIK I 2급Total 140 or more (e.g. listening 70 + reading 70)
TOPIK II 3급Total 120 or more (e.g. listening 50 + writing 20 + reading 50)
TOPIK II 4급Total 150 or more (e.g. listening 60 + writing 30 + reading 60)

Find your 약점 (weak points)

After a practice test, count which type you got wrong most: places? main idea? blanks? Then go back and study that lesson in this app.

Each section is worth 100 points. Writing in TOPIK II is hard, so many people get most of their points from listening and reading.

tq.dl: Listening 40 + reading 35: what level is it?
tq.x: 40 + 35 = 75. 1급 needs 80 or more, so you are 5 points short.

tq.d: TOPIK II에서 듣기 55점, 쓰기 25점, 읽기 60점이면 몇 급입니까?
tq.dl: Listening 55 + writing 25 + reading 60: what level is it?

tq.d: TOPIK II 4급이 목표입니다. 듣기 60점, 읽기 65점이면 쓰기는 최소 몇 점이 필요합니까?

o: Study the 'main idea' lesson and practice that type of question
Take the test again right away
tq.x: Find your weak points (약점) and practice that type in the listening or reading section of this app.

info:
Writing question 52: explanatory text

This question type

㉠ 일부러 웃으면
㉡ 웃음은 기분에 영향을 준다

1. When you start a new paragraph, leave 1 box empty.

2. 1 syllable = 1 box. Marks like . , also take 1 box.

3. Numbers and English letters: 2 in 1 box.

4. In IBT you type without boxes, but you still need to count characters.

Use -다 / -ㄴ다 / -는다 in every sentence.

info:
Writing practice for questions 53·54 + sample answers

쓰기 53·54번 실전 + 모범 답안

How to do it

1. Read the topic and write your own answer on paper or type it (53: 30 minutes including 51~52, 54: 30 minutes). 2. Compare with the sample. 3. Check with the checklist (questions below).

Question 53

다음은 '외국인 유학생의 한국 생활 만족도'에 대한 조사 결과이다. 이 내용을 200~300자의 글로 쓰시오.
조사 대상: 외국인 유학생 1,000명
만족 2019년 45% → 2025년 68%
만족하는 이유: ① 좋은 교육 환경 ② 편리한 교통
불만족 이유: 언어 문제

Sample answer 53

외국인 유학생 1,000명을 대상으로 한국 생활 만족도를 조사한 결과, 만족한다는 응답이 2019년 45%에서 2025년 68%로 크게 증가한 것으로 나타났다. 만족하는 이유로는 좋은 교육 환경이 가장 많았고, 편리한 교통이 그 뒤를 이었다. 반면 만족하지 못하는 이유로는 언어 문제가 꼽혔다. 따라서 앞으로 한국어 교육을 늘린다면 만족도는 더 높아질 것으로 보인다.

Question 54

요즘 많은 사람들이 SNS를 사용한다. 'SNS의 장점과 단점'에 대해 600~700자로 쓰시오.
· SNS의 장점은 무엇인가?
· SNS의 단점은 무엇인가?
· SNS를 바르게 사용하려면 어떻게 해야 하는가?

Sample answer 54 (shortened)

오늘날 SNS는 많은 사람들의 생활에서 빼놓을 수 없는 부분이 되었다. 그렇다면 SNS의 장점과 단점은 무엇이며, 어떻게 사용해야 할까?
먼저 SNS의 가장 큰 장점은 멀리 있는 사람과도 쉽게 소통할 수 있다는 것이다. 또한 다양한 정보를 빠르게 얻을 수 있다. …
반면에 SNS에는 단점도 있다. 확인되지 않은 정보가 빠르게 퍼질 수 있고, 지나치게 사용하면 개인의 시간을 빼앗긴다. …
따라서 SNS를 바르게 사용하기 위해서는 정보를 비판적으로 받아들이고 사용 시간을 스스로 정하는 태도가 필요하다. …

Words

만족도 manjokdolevel of satisfaction
응답 eungdapresponse (survey)
꼽히다 kkopidato be named, to be picked
소통하다 sotonghadato communicate
비판적 bipanjeokcritical

Trap choices

함정 선택지 분석

Common traps

If you know the patterns of wrong choices, you can cross them out fast.

① Same words you heardIt has words you heard, but the meaning is different
② Person changedThe man did it → the choice says the woman did it
③ Time changed했다 (did) ↔ 할 것이다 (will do)
④ Too strong항상, 모두, 절대, 반드시 that the text did not say
⑤ Partly trueHalf right, half wrong
⑥ Numbers changedDates, prices, amounts

Words

함정 hamjeongtrap
항상 hangsangalways
모두 moduall
절대 jeoldaenever, absolutely
반드시 bandeusimust, surely
일부 ilbusome, a part

tq.dl: Why is this choice wrong?
tq.p:
본문: 여자는 어제 친구와 영화를 봤다.
선택지: 여자는 내일 친구와 영화를 볼 것이다.
tq.x: 어제 봤다 → 내일 볼 것이다: time changed.

tq.dl: Why is this choice wrong?
tq.p:
본문: 남자가 발표 자료를 복사했다.
선택지: 여자가 발표 자료를 복사했다.
tq.x: Man → woman: person changed.

tq.dl: Why is this choice wrong?
tq.p:
본문: 저는 가끔 운동을 합니다.
선택지: 저는 항상 운동을 합니다.
tq.x: 가끔 → 항상: too strong.

tq.dl: Why is this choice wrong?
tq.p:
본문: 신청은 11월 28일까지이고 대회는 12월 5일이다.
선택지: 신청은 12월 5일까지이다.
tq.x: The date of something else was mixed in.

tq.dl: Why is this choice wrong?
tq.p:
본문: 사과는 맛있지만 비싸다.
선택지: 사과는 맛있고 싸다.

tq.dl: Why is this choice wrong?
tq.p:

선택지: 서점에서 책을 샀다.

tq.x: You heard 책, but the place and action are different.

본문: 일부 학생은 반대했다.

tq.x: 일부 (some) ↔ 모든 (all).

tq.x: Words that say too much are often traps.

info:
Introduction to the TOPIK speaking test

TOPIK 말하기 평가 소개

What is it?

The TOPIK 말하기 평가 is a separate test from TOPIK I·II. It is done on a computer: you see the question on the screen, speak into a microphone, and the system records your voice (녹음).

There are about 6 questions. Each question has 준비 시간 (preparation time) and then 답변 시간 (answer time). Results are given as a level.

The number of questions, time and test places can change, and some countries do not have it yet. Check topik.go.kr first.

1질문에 대답하기 · answer simple questions about yourself
2그림 보고 역할 수행하기 · look at a picture and play a role
3그림 보고 이야기하기 · tell a story from several pictures
4대화 완성하기 · listen and continue the conversation
5자료 해석하기 · explain a graph
6의견 제시하기 · give your opinion

Words

녹음 nogeumrecording
준비 시간 junbi siganpreparation time
답변 dapbyeonanswer
평가 pyeonggaassessment

info:
Answering questions·speaking from pictures

질문에 답하기·그림 보고 말하기

Answering questions

Answer in full sentences and add 1 reason. Don't just answer '네'.

Telling a story from pictures

Use order words: 먼저 → 그다음에 → 그런데 → 결국.

Giving your opinion

저는 -다고 생각합니다. 왜냐하면 -기 때문입니다. 따라서 -는 것이 좋겠습니다.

Sample answers

질문: 주말에 보통 무엇을 합니까?
저는 주말에 보통 친구들과 같이 운동을 합니다. 평일에는 수업과 과제 때문에 바빠서 운동할 시간이 없기 때문입니다. 운동을 하고 나면 스트레스가 풀려서 기분이 좋아집니다.
그림: ① 🏠 늦잠 ② 🏃 뛰어서 정류장 ③ 🚌 버스가 떠남 ④ 🚕 택시
민하 씨는 아침에 늦잠을 잤습니다. 그래서 정류장까지 뛰어갔습니다. 그런데 버스가 이미 떠나 버렸습니다. 결국 민하 씨는 택시를 타고 학교에 갔습니다.

Words

먼저 meonjeofirst
그다음에 geudaeumenext
결국 gyeolgukin the end
생각하다 saenggakadato think
